steps.note: Open the prepared completed eRFX RFQ project's summary page.
Enable eRFX project features required by the case.
Allow recreating or cloning the completed project.
Open the stage Settings menu and choose Recreate Order.
Keep the default recreation settings and create the new event.
Verify that the recreated event opens on its create screen.
Verify that the recreated event remains an RFQ-only eRFX project.
Verify that the recreated event contains the same number of line items as the prepared source event.
